# Travels — Curated Maps by Girard-Davila
# https://travels.girard-davila.net/
# Format: https://llmstxt.org

> Hand-picked travel maps from real family experiences across South East Asia and Europe. GPS-precise spots, honest notes, opening hours and prices. No generic tourist lists.

## About

Girard-Davila Travels is a curated travel map project built from personal travel experience. Each destination map contains GPS-verified POIs with category filters, opening hours, prices and insider notes. Maps are built with Hugo, Leaflet.js and GeoJSON/TopoJSON, deployed on GitHub Pages.

## Destinations

- [Koh Samui, Thailand](https://travels.girard-davila.net/koh-samui/): Beaches, spas, restaurants and activities across the island — Lamai, Chaweng, Maenam. Includes Tamarind Springs Forest Spa, Karma Two Palms Beach Club, local gyms and padel courts.
- [Hoi An, Vietnam](https://travels.girard-davila.net/hoi-an/): An Hoi peninsula — restaurants, cafés, local market, Buddhist pagoda and river viewpoints around the Na Mom Homestay area.
- [Gulf of Thailand Fishing Expedition](https://travels.girard-davila.net/fishing-boat/): 2-day boat expedition from Nathon Pier — red snapper grounds, tuna alley, overnight anchorage. TopoJSON format demo with multi-segment route and waypoints.

## Features

- Interactive maps powered by Leaflet.js and OpenStreetMap tiles
- Category filters: Beach, Restaurant, Café, Activity, Hotel, Shopping
- URL filter parameters (e.g. ?filter=Beach) for shareable filtered views
- Opening hours and price information on enhanced POIs
- VIP locked spots (🔒) for members — hidden gems not published openly
- Floating contact form on all pages (Formspree)
- **Map toolbar** on every map: download GeoJSON, export GPX for OsmAnd, embed as iframe, share URL, load custom data
- **OsmAnd integration**: `geo:lat,lon` links on every POI for direct navigation
- **Custom GeoJSON/TopoJSON loading**: load any file from disk or URL onto the map
- **GitHub integration**: sign in with GitHub (Device Flow OAuth or PAT), load GeoJSON from your repos, submit PRs to add your maps to this project
- **TopoJSON support**: route lines and waypoints in TopoJSON format (Gulf of Thailand demo)
- **GPX export**: all POIs and routes exported as GPX for use with OsmAnd, Garmin, and other GPS apps

## VIP Access

Some POIs are reserved for VIP members (€4.99/month). These appear as locked cards in the sidebar. After unlocking via Stripe, members get full GPS coordinates, insider notes and access to all future VIP spots across all destinations.

## Custom Maps

Personalised travel maps can be requested via the contact form. Maps are built from real Girard-Davila family travel experience — not tourist brochures. Destinations covered include South East Asia (Thailand, Vietnam) and Europe.

## Open Source / Contribution

The site is open source on GitHub. Any user can:
1. Sign in with their GitHub account via the map toolbar
2. Load their own GeoJSON or TopoJSON file onto the map
3. Submit a pull request to add their map to the upstream repository

## Technical

- Built with: Hugo (static site generator)
- Maps: Leaflet.js + OpenStreetMap
- Data formats: GeoJSON, TopoJSON (via topojson-client@3)
- Data: static/koh-samui/locations.geojson, static/hoi-an/locations.geojson, static/fishing-boat/route.topojson
- GitHub OAuth: Device Flow via Cloudflare Worker CORS proxy (workers/github-proxy.js)
- GPX export: client-side GeoJSON → GPX conversion
- Geocoding: LocationIQ forward geocoding API
- Hosting: GitHub Pages (travels.girard-davila.net)
- Source: https://github.com/alx/travel-guide
